summary: Focused testing on the new Functional Movement Assessment module (backend + frontend) plus full regression of prior JointCare flows. Backend pytest suite is now 26/26 passing (added 6 new movement tests). Frontend Playwright verified /app/movement renders with patient-select, all 5 test tabs (sit_to_stand, single_leg_balance, tug, squat, gait), all 4 live-metric tiles (live-knee-left/right, live-hip-angle, live-posture); selecting a patient enables PoseCamera area; start-test-button starts countdown-timer and swaps to stop-test-button; test-progress renders; rep-counter present for sit_to_stand; stop-test-button produces a test-result-card and the tab shows a check svg; save-assessment-button POSTs to /api/movement-assessments, shows 'Movement assessment saved (score 0%)' toast, navigates to /app/patients/{id} where movement-history and start-movement-button are present. Camera absence in headless is expected: quality_score = 0 but SAVE flow works. New screenings created AFTER a movement assessment correctly attach movement_summary (overall_score, movement_risk_level, test_count) — verified via API.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py MovementTest.quality_score default is 0 (not Optional) so filter 'if t.get(quality_score) is not None' is effectively always true — fine, but the intended fallback to skip missing scores never triggers. Minor.

_movement_risk thresholds Low>=75 / Moderate>=55 / High>=35 / else Severe — an assessment with all quality_score=0 (camera-less env) is labelled 'Severe'. Consider surfacing a distinct 'no-data' state so demo/test screenshots don't show a Severe badge when no landmarks were captured.

GET /api/movement-assessments has no auth-scoping/ownership check — any authenticated user can list any patient's assessments (matches existing pattern for /screenings, so consistent but worth noting).
create_screening embeds only the latest movement_summary snapshot; if a later movement assessment is added, older screenings keep the stale snapshot (expected, but not documented).
test_credentials: Admin: lakshyabahety15@gmail.com / JointCare@2026 (existing). Worker/doctor accounts generated per pytest run.
seed_data_creation: Per test run: 1 TEST_Patient_<uniq> under a fresh healthcare worker; 2 screenings (one worker-created, one created AFTER the movement assessment to verify movement_summary attachment); 3 movement assessments (2-test, 1-test severe, and the UI-driven one).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Camera is unavailable in headless (WASM loads but getUserMedia returns no real frames) -> live metrics stay --, quality_score = 0, overall risk = Severe. That is EXPECTED and the SAVE flow still succeeds. Backend movement tests live alongside existing suite in /app/backend/tests/test_jointcare_api.py. Use shadcn Select clicks with force=True + [role=option] locator (native <option> is hidden). Stop test with data-testid=stop-test-button — do NOT wait for the 30s countdown to finish in E2E, click stop after ~1-2s to keep runtime short.
rca of the issue: No blocking bugs found. All movement endpoints and UI wiring work as specified. Note MediaPipe WebGL 'GPU stall due to ReadPixels' warnings appear in console during camera init in headless — harmless in a test env, and it silences itself after ~4 occurrences.
